# Biblical Archaeology Society

> The Biblical Archaeology Society is a nonprofit educational organization dedicated to advancing knowledge of biblical archaeology through publications, digital resources, travel programs, and archaeological discoveries.

BAS publishes the renowned Biblical Archaeology Review (BAR) magazine and maintains the BAS Library, a comprehensive digital archive of archaeological research and biblical history. The organization offers travel study programs, volunteer dig opportunities, and educational courses connecting scholarly discoveries to biblical texts and ancient civilizations.

## Key Topics

- Biblical Archaeology Review (BAR)
- BAS Library

## Core Resources

- [Home - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org): Homepage of Biblical Archaeology Society, nonprofit dedicated to biblical archaeology education.
- [Magazine - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/magazines): Biblical Archaeology Review magazine archive and current issues.
- [Home - The BAS Library](https://library.biblicalarchaeology.org): Digital library with archives of BAR, Bible Review, and Archaeology Odyssey magazines.
- [Knowledge BAR - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/knowledge-bar): Reference guide and learning hub for biblical archaeology basics and education.
- [About the Biblical Archaeology Society - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/about-the-biblical-archaeology-society): About page describing BAS mission, publications, and educational resources.

## Blog & News

- [Blog - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/blog): Bible History Daily blog featuring archaeology news and latest biblical discoveries.
- [Unprecedented Discoveries of Christian Baptism Found on the Shore of Galilee - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/biblical-artifacts/artifacts-and-the-bible/unprecedented-discoveries-christian-baptism-found-shore-of-galilee): Byzantine cathedral discoveries revealing early Christian baptismal rites at Sea of Galilee.
- [Setting the BAR - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/archaeology-today/setting-the-bar): History of Biblical Archaeology Review magazine marking 50 years of groundbreaking reporting.
- [The Only Ancient Jewish Male Hair Ever Found - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/ancient-cultures/ancient-israel/the-only-ancient-jewish-hair-ever-found): Rare Second Temple period Jewish hair discovery from Tomb of the Shroud by James Tabor.
- [Biblical Bread: Baking Like the Ancient Israelites - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/ancient-cultures/daily-life-and-practice/biblical-bread-baking-like-the-ancient-israelites): Experimental archaeology recreating ancient Israelite bread-baking at Tell Halif.
- [Why the Tower of Babel Is So Hard to Explain - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/ancient-cultures/why-the-tower-of-babel-is-so-hard-to-explain): Analysis of Tower of Babel interpretation and archaeological evidence from Genesis.
- [Bible Secrets Revealed, Episode 3: "The Forbidden Scriptures" - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/biblical-topics/bible-secrets-revealed-episode-3-the-forbidden-scriptures): Episode summary on excluded biblical texts and the origins of the biblical canon.
- [Biblical Archaeology Review, Spring 2026 - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/magazine-issue/biblical-archaeology-review-spring-2026): Spring 2026 magazine issue featuring archaeological discoveries and excavations.

## Travel & Fieldwork

- [Travel - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/travel): Travel study programs and seminars in biblical archaeology destinations.
- [Digs - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/digs): Archaeological dig volunteer opportunities in Israel, Jordan, and Middle East.
- [BAS Class with Lawrence Mykytiuk - Biblical Archaeology Society](https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/travel-study/bas-class-with-lawrence-mykytiuk): Online course on Hebrew Bible historicity and ancient inscriptions with Mykytiuk.
